prompt:
Create a looping animation of a curling athlete sweeping an object in front of them. The character holds a broom with both hands: top hand near chest height, lower hand near waist height. Start in an athletic forward stance with staggered feet, knees bent, torso leaned slightly forward.
During the loop, the broom head stays in contact with the ground. Perform a fast left-right scrubbing motion that pushes debris away from the character. Show shoulder and torso rotation, slight elbow flex at extremes, and stable lower-body posture with subtle weight shifts. Feet stay planted. Maintain correct broom alignment with the ground. Use a realistic, energetic rhythm (about 4–6 strokes per second). Ensure the loop is seamless with no visible reset.
